blurb: Guests can book sport fishing charters on various boats ranging from 24ft to 70ft with bilingual crews, fishing licenses, live bait, and equipment included. Whale watching tours and snorkeling trips are also offered with bilingual staff and government permits. Additional local tours include scuba diving, ATV, parasailing, horseback riding, and beach activities.
